question: Which tunnel protocol does the NetAssist tunnel broker use (6in4, GRE or WireGuard)? No first-party page read on 2026-11-03 names it: tb.netassist.ua, its registration form and netassist.ua/en/service/ipv6 describe the broker, the /48 prefix and the IPv4 endpoint field only, and the FAQ and help paths answer 404.
why: The rung of egress/netassist-tb stays unverified because the tooling field depends on the protocol; third-party reports (a router-script gist, a tunnel broker list) say 6in4 or GRE, which is reported, not documented. One vendor sentence, or the configuration pages behind the login, would settle it.
